Central Washington University to participate in Great Washington ShakeOut drill
Central Washington University will join others statewide for the Great Washington ShakeOut earthquake drill on Oct. 15. The event includes a campus-wide safety exercise and activities focused on emergency preparedness.
Central Washington University will join institutions around the state for the Great Washington ShakeOut on Oct. 15.
The CWU Resilience Rally, sponsored by the Office of Emergency Management and the Information Technology Management department, is scheduled to take place at exactly 10:16 a.m. During this event, faculty, staff, and students will participate in a “drop, cover, and hold on” drill. Following the drill, ITM student-led stations will be available to explore the university’s preparedness level and offer participants an opportunity to take the Resilience Challenge. ITM faculty will also be involved in this training exercise.
According to organizers, "The goal of the CWU Resilience Rally is to help Wildcats understand their role, build a preparedness kit, verify contact information, and support each other in an emergency."
The Great Washington ShakeOut is part of International ShakeOut Day, when millions of people worldwide participate in earthquake drills at work, school, and home. The CWU community will be joining people across Washington for this safety drill, which varies by state and institution.
ShakeOut Day also serves as an opportunity for communities to test their tsunami evacuation routes. The state's tsunami sirens are scheduled to be tested on Thursday.
